reason: I tried magnesium before and felt no difference, so I'm not going to pay for another bottle on the strength of a nice jar and a pretty website. I'd rather see it help someone I know before I spend money on it.
objection: I already spent money on magnesium that did nothing for me, and this sounds the same. Sugar and glucose syrup in a 'supplement' also makes me wonder how much magnesium is really in each gummy.
would_change_my_mind: A friend I trust, who isn't being paid, tells me it helped her sleep over a few weeks.
